    • deserialize

      public void deserialize(ArrayList<String> leftover)
      Description copied from class: Setting
      Deserializes the setting's value from a list of strings. It searches for a string containing the serialized name of this setting, parses its value, and updates the setting. If no match is found or parsing fails, the setting is reset to its default value.
      Specified by:
      deserialize in interface SettingsChild
      Overrides:
      deserialize in class Setting<T>
      Parameters:
      leftover - An ArrayList of strings from which to deserialize the setting.

    • serialize

      public ArrayList<String> serialize()
      Description copied from class: Setting
      Serializes the current setting into a list of strings. For a single setting, this typically returns a list containing one string in the format "settingName = settingValue".
      Specified by:
      serialize in interface SettingsChild
      Overrides:
      serialize in class Setting<T>
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of strings representing the serialized setting.
